notes: Candidate records came from the retained real artifact inspection result.
Candidate rows were read to completion from bounded WarpViz GTAPI pages.
Markers are normalized from each queue's main hierarchy; alternate hierarchy views are not duplicated.

Shader Profiler rows expose sampled performance only; exact invocation counts, occupancy, and divergence are omitted when GTAPI does not report them. dominantStalls contains at most the top three GTAPI-ordered reasons contributing at least 1% of the shader scope.

Shader Profiler hotspots are the deterministic union of GTAPI per-shader partitions keyed by deviceIndex, shaderIndex, sourceType, and partition-local hotspotIndex. source/intermediate/SASS rows are overlapping representations and must not be summed. samplePercent uses the total samples for the same device and full-trace range, so percentages are comparable only within one device/range. Unavailable evidence is omitted, and source-line text is never inlined.
GTAPI shader-source descriptor queries succeeded with zero files; shader_sources is supported-empty, not unavailable.
Frame and marker duration metrics are mechanically derived from GTAPI nanosecond ranges; sampled metric values use the full trace range.
Marker duration metric rows omit frame.index and percent_of_frame: the generic GTAPI marker-list record does not carry exact frame membership, and this provider does not invent that correlation.

Action rows omit canonical frame.index: GTAPI in_frame_index is an action ordinal within a frame, not the owning frame identity, and exact temporal frame correlation is not implemented by this generic reader.
